description: Defines the FunctionsGLX class for loading and managing GLX functions and data, including context creation, extension querying, and buffer swapping, specific to the ANGLE project on Linux/Unix systems.

classes.name: FunctionsGLX
classes.description: Class responsible for loading and managing GLX functions and extensions for rendering context management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads GLX data and extensions from the display.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with GLX.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific GLX extension is supported.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a GLX context current for a drawable.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: queryExtension
methods.description: Queries extension error base and event numbers.

methods.name: waitGL
methods.description: Waits for GL commands to complete.

methods.name: queryExtensionsString
methods.description: Returns supported GLX extensions as a string.

methods.name: chooseFBConfig
methods.description: Selects a framebuffer configuration based on attributes.

methods.name: getFBConfigAttrib
methods.description: Gets an attribute value from a framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: getVisualFromFBConfig
methods.description: Gets visual info from a framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a window with a framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: createContextAttribsARB
methods.description: Creates a GLX context with specific attributes (ARB extension).
